content: Prisma 6 + Supabase: Use two connection strings. DATABASE_URL points to transaction pooler (port 6543, ?pgbouncer=true) for all runtime queries — disables prepared statements which is required. DIRECT_URL points to direct connection (port 5432) and is used exclusively by prisma migrate and prisma db push. Prisma 6 min Node 18.18, min TypeScript 5.1. Buffer replaced with Uint8Array for Bytes. Breaking: fullTextSearchPostgres now requires preview flag.
